selection.rule: Homepage events come from current RSS/advisory sources. CVEs are shown only when the source article/advisory mentions them.

items.title: Maersk confirms data breach as WhiteArmor ransomware demands $5 million
items.summary: Maersk announced that a threat actor gained unauthorized access to a local legacy system inherited through an earlier acquisition and extracted data from it. [...]
items.title_zh: 馬士基確認資料外洩事故，WhiteArmor 勒索軟體索要 500 萬美元
items.summary_zh: 馬士基宣布威脅者未經授權存取了透過早期收購所繼承的本地舊版系統，並從中擷取了資料。

items.title: Critical Xen Orchestra Flaws Exploited in Attacks
items.summary: A critical authentication bypass allows attackers to execute arbitrary code as admin and take over XCP-ng nodes. The post Critical Xen Orchestra Flaws Exploited in Attacks appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: Xen Orchestra 重大漏洞在攻擊中遭利用
items.summary_zh: 一項重大身分驗證繞過漏洞允許攻擊者以管理員身分執行任意程式碼並接管 XCP-ng 節點。《Critical Xen Orchestra Flaws Exploited in Attacks》這篇文章首先出現在 SecurityWeek。

items.title: N-able releases security hotfixes for zero-day vulnerabilities
items.summary: N-able released hotfixes to address zero-day bugs affecting its N-central remote monitoring and management (RMM) platform, which were publicly disclosed over the weekend and forced it to take vulnerable hosted environments offline. [...]
items.title_zh: N-able 為零日漏洞發布安全熱修復程式
items.summary_zh: N-able 發布了熱修復程式，以修復影響其 N-central 遠端監控與管理（RMM）平台的零日漏洞；這些漏洞於週末被公開披露，並迫使該公司將受影響的託管環境下線。

items.title: CISA flags Cisco BroadWorks flaw as actively exploited in attacks
items.summary: The US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) warned on Tuesday that hackers are now exploiting a high-severity Cisco BroadWorks vulnerability in attacks. [...]
items.title_zh: CISA 警示 Cisco BroadWorks 漏洞正於攻擊中遭積極利用
items.summary_zh: 美國網路安全暨基礎設施安全局（CISA）於週二發出警告，指出駭客目前正在攻擊中利用一個高嚴重性的 Cisco BroadWorks 漏洞。

items.title: CISA Adds Six Known Exploited Vulnerabilities to Catalog
items.summary: CISA has added six new vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog , based on evidence of active exploitation. items.title_zh: CISA 將六個已知被利用的漏洞新增至目錄
items.summary_zh: CISA 根據積極利用的證據，將六個新漏洞新增至其已知被利用漏洞（KEV）目錄中。CVE-2026-20320 Cisco BroadWorks XML 外部實體參照限制不當漏洞、CVE-2026-111560 Barracuda Networks 多款產品作業系統命令注入漏洞、CVE-2026-111793 Openwave Messagin...

items.title: CISA Adds Four Known Exploited Vulnerabilities to Catalog
items.summary: CISA has added four new vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog , based on evidence of active exploitation. CVE-2026-102895 GPUStack Improper Authentication Vulnerability CVE-2026-116779 SignalWire FreeSwitch Code Injection Vulnerability CVE-2026-123158 OpenBSD OpenSSH Unexpected Status Code or Return Value Vulnerability CVE-2...
items.title_zh: CISA 將四個已知已被利用的漏洞新增至目錄
items.summary_zh: CISA 根據主動利用的證據，在其已知已被利用漏洞（KEV）目錄中新增了四個新漏洞：CVE-2026-102895 GPUStack 不當身份驗證漏洞、CVE-2026-116779 SignalWire FreeSwitch 程式碼注入漏洞、CVE-2026-123158 OpenBSD OpenSSH 異常狀態碼或傳回值漏洞、CVE-2...

items.summary: CISA has added one new vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog , based on evidence of active exploitation. CVE-2026-19868 SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN Use of Single-factor Authentication Vulnerability This type of vulnerability is a frequent attack vector for malicious cyber actors and poses significant risks to the federal enterpri...
items.title_zh: CISA 將一個已知被利用的漏洞新增至目錄
items.summary_zh: CISA 根據主動利用的證據，在其已知被利用漏洞（KEV）目錄中新增了一個新漏洞。CVE-2026-19868 SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN 使用單因子驗證漏洞。此類漏洞是惡意網路行為者常用的攻擊途徑，對聯邦企業構成重大風險...

items.summary: Overview The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA), Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI), Health and Human Services (HHS), U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA), and the Department of Transportation (DoT)—hereafter referred to as “the authoring organizations”—are aware of malicious cyber activity targeting industrial refrigeration and c...
items.title_zh: 美國政府夥伴呼籲加強工業冷凍和冷鏈監控系統的安全防禦
items.summary_zh: 概述：網路安全暨基礎設施安全局（CISA）、聯邦調查局（FBI）、美國衛生與公眾服務部（HHS）、美國農業部（USDA）及美國運輸部（DoT）——以下簡稱「編撰組織」——已意識到針對工業冷凍和冷鏈監控系統的惡意網路活動...

items.title: Citrix, Ivanti Patch Critical and High-Severity Vulnerabilities
items.summary: Attackers could exploit the bugs to tamper with certificate entries, achieve remote code execution, and compromise hosts. The post Citrix, Ivanti Patch Critical and High-Severity Vulnerabilities appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: Citrix 與 Ivanti 修補重大及高嚴重性漏洞
items.summary_zh: 攻擊者可利用這些漏洞篡改憑證項目、實現遠端程式碼執行並入侵主機。《Citrix, Ivanti Patch Critical and High-Severity Vulnerabilities》這篇文章首先出現在 SecurityWeek。

items.title: Baker Tilly notifies clients of data breach at third-party provider
items.summary: The Baker Tilly Advisory Group is notifying clients that a data breach has compromised certain personal information about them and their dependents. [...]
items.title_zh: Baker Tilly 通知客戶第三方提供業者發生資料洩漏事件
items.summary_zh: Baker Tilly Advisory Group 正通知客戶，一場資料洩漏事件已妥協了他們及其受撫養人的特定個人資訊。[...]

items.title: Active ScreenConnect attacks breach MSPs, impact dozens of organizations
items.summary: ConnectWise is investigating an active malware campaign targeting managed service providers (MSPs) that uses compromised ScreenConnect environments to deploy rogue remote-access clients to customer devices. [...]
items.title_zh: 針對 ScreenConnect 的活躍攻擊入侵 MSP，影響數十個組織
items.summary_zh: ConnectWise 正深入調查一項針對託管服務提供業者（MSP）的活躍惡意程式活動，該活動利用已遭入侵的 ScreenConnect 環境向客戶裝置部署未授權的遠端存取用戶端。[...]

items.title: Notion says Fireworks breach exposed customer AI chat transcripts
items.summary: Notion, the digital workspace platform, disclosed that a security breach at its AI infrastructure provider, Fireworks AI, exposed Notion AI chat transcripts in a small number of workspaces. [...]
items.title_zh: Notion 表示 Fireworks 資料洩漏事件外洩了客戶的 AI 聊天紀錄
items.summary_zh: 數位工作區平台 Notion 披露，其 AI 基礎設施提供業者 Fireworks AI 發生的安全入侵事件，導致少數工作區內的 Notion AI 聊天紀錄遭到外洩。[...]

items.title: Railway breach leads to $740,000 in fraudulent AI charges
items.summary: Cloud hosting provider Railway says hackers exploited vulnerabilities in its infrastructure to steal customer authentication secrets and generate approximately $740,000 in fraudulent AI usage, potentially exposing credentials for up to 100,000 workspaces. [...]
items.title_zh: Railway 資料外洩事件導致 74 萬美元的欺詐性 AI 費用
items.summary_zh: 雲端託管服務提供商 Railway 表示，駭客利用其基礎設施中的漏洞竊取客戶身份驗證機密，並產生約 740,000 美元的欺詐性 AI 使用費，可能暴露多達 100,000 個工作區的憑證。[...]

items.title: Hackers exploit trusted AWS access to breach multiple cloud environments
items.summary: A threat actor used compromised identity and access management (IAM) credentials for a Qubole big data platform's AWS account to access and exfiltrate data from multiple customers' AWS environments. [...]
items.title_zh: 駭客利用受信任的 AWS 存取權入侵多個雲端環境
items.summary_zh: 威脅誘因者利用 Qubole 大數據平台 AWS 帳號遭入侵的存取身份與管理（IAM）憑證，存取並外洩來自多個客戶 AWS 環境的資料。[...]

items.title: Asus, Zoom Release Security Patches
items.summary: Attackers could exploit them for command execution, memory overwrites, and privilege escalation. The post Asus, Zoom Release Security Patches appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: Asus 與 Zoom 發布安全補丁
items.summary_zh: 攻擊者可利用這些漏洞進行指令執行、記憶體覆寫以及權限提升。「Asus 與 Zoom 發布安全補丁」這篇文章首次出現在 SecurityWeek 上。

items.title: Hackers use AntiFox AI agents in AWS credential-theft attacks
items.summary: Attackers are using Alibaba Cloud to host self-managed instances of AntiFox, an open-source agentic penetration testing platform, to target web services and AWS environments. [...]
items.title_zh: 駭客在 AWS 憑證竊取攻擊中使用 AntiFox AI 代理
items.summary_zh: 攻擊者正利用阿里雲託管自建的 AntiFox（一個開源代理式滲透測試平台）軟體實例，以此瞄準 Web 服務與 AWS 環境。[...]

items.title: eBPF Rootkits: Why Underground Actors Are Taking Notice
items.summary: Linux eBPF rootkits can hide malicious activity and evade traditional detection methods without loading kernel modules. Flare reveals how these techniques are spreading through underground forums, where threat actors are sharing rootkit source code, tutorials, and exploits targeting Linux systems. [...]
items.title_zh: eBPF Rootkit：地下威脅份子關注其發展的原因
items.summary_zh: Linux eBPF Rootkit 無需載入核心模組即可隱藏惡意活動並規避傳統偵測方法。Flare 揭露了這些技術如何在地下論壇中傳播，威脅份子正於論壇中分享針對 Linux 系統的 Rootkit 原始碼、教學課程與漏洞利用程式。[...]

items.title: Threat Actors Exploit Openwave, Cisco BroadWorks Vulnerabilities
items.summary: The flaws, CVE-2026-111793 and CVE-2026-20320, let attackers leak sensitive information, including configuration data. The post Threat Actors Exploit Openwave, Cisco BroadWorks Vulnerabilities appeared first on SecurityWeek .
items.title_zh: 威脅份子利用 Openwave 與 Cisco BroadWorks 漏洞
items.summary_zh: 漏洞 CVE-2026-111793 與 CVE-2026-20320 可讓攻擊者外洩敏感資訊，包含組態資料。這篇「威脅份子利用 Openwave 與 Cisco BroadWorks 漏洞」文章最早發表於 SecurityWeek。

items.title: Japanese furniture giant Nitori says hackers stole 37.6M customer records
items.summary: Nitori, a major Japanese furniture and home accessories retailer, discovered that an attacker accessed a system on its network and may have stolen 37.62 million customer records. [...]
items.title_zh: 日本家具巨擘宜得利表示駭客竊取了 3760 萬筆客戶記錄
items.summary_zh: 日本大型家具和家居用品零售商宜得利（Nitori）發現攻擊者存取了其網路上的某個系統，並可能竊取了 3762 萬筆客戶記錄。[...]
